messages:
michael: planning to push console/ui v3.12.0 today 16:30 PT. primary goals: canary at 10% for ~15min, warm CDN caches for new bundles, run smoke e2e. who can own canary + rollback readiness?

anya: I can own the canary and smoke checks. will watch Sentry + console traces. what are the purge keys and sequence?

michael: @anya thanks. fastly surrogate-key is "console-assets-v3.12.0". plan: 1) warm top assets, 2) partial surrogate-key purge for bundles, 3) full purge only if needed after smoke. commands below.

michael: ```
# warm (hits to populate edges)
for url in $(cat new-assets.txt); do curl -I -s "$url" > /dev/null; done
# partial purge
fastlyctl purge --service=rw-console --surrogate-key="console-assets-v3.12.0"
# full purge (pre-approved)
fastlyctl purge --service=rw-console --all
```

kevin: QA smoke checklist (summary):
- visit / and login with test org
- open workspace list + editor load (large prompt to check tokenization perf)
- verify top bundle 200 + correct hash
- run e2e: `npm run smoke -- --env=staging` pegged to the canary slot

jen: I'll run the e2e and post results here. ETA ~17:00 PT.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment created: canary-id=cny-1789 slot=10% started by michael at 2026-03-17T16:30:10Z

lisa: rollback thresholds: >=3 errors in 5m OR P95 latency > 700ms. rollback steps:
- flip feature flag `console:v3_active=false` (fastest)
- or `kubectl set image deployment/console ui=registry.redwood/console:v3.11.9 --record` to revert image
Ensure previous replicaset exists.

anya: i'll handle tracing and perf dashboards. i'll also prime the top 50 assets via the warm loop.

michael: whoever runs any purge, drop the exact command + timestamp here. after canary + smoke pass we'll ramp to 50% then 100% (30min window). :thumbsup:

jen: starting e2e now, will post logs when done.

michael: checklist status:
- canary up (anya) [in progress]
- warm caches (anya) [in progress]
- smoke e2e (jen) [running]
- monitor (lisa, kevin)
- CDN final purge (michael) [hold until smoke pass]

michael: cc: @sre-oncall for extra eyes

deploy-bot: Canary health: OK (5m) errors=0 latency_p95=320ms

jen: smoke done: all checks green, artifact hashes match. e2e logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4321

michael: agreed to ramp. will do 50% at 17:05 PT then 100% at 17:25 PT if stable.

lisa: traces look clean so far. :thumbsup:

michael: starting 50% now — command: `kubectl set image deployment/console ui=registry.redwood/console:v3.12.0 --record`

deploy-bot: Rollout status: 50% ramp complete; progressing.

kevin: watching mem/cpu and edge error rates. nothing abnormal yet.

michael: holding final full purge until 17:40 PT to let edges settle. then i'll run full `fastlyctl purge --all`.

anya: noted, will keep watching dashboards and spike alerts.

deploy-bot: Rollout complete: 100% at 17:28 PT; no errors flagged.

michael: final purge executed at 17:41 PT by michael. command: `fastlyctl purge --service=rw-console --all`

jen: spot-checked top pages and assets, no 404s. all good.

michael: thanks team. filing release note and closing thread.
